full_prompt_en: A square fine-art studio photograph isolates a single barefoot dancer in a twisting, off-balance leap before a smooth warm-gray wall. The figure is held near the center but stretches diagonally from the upper left to the lower right, with wide empty gray space around the movement. A broad white brimmed hat tilts forward and hides the face entirely, giving the pose an anonymous, sculptural quality. The dancer wears loose, weathered cream and taupe garments: long sleeves, a layered top, and generously cut trousers whose cloth gathers and creases around bent joints. One knee folds high toward the chest while the other leg kicks right with the bare foot extended. One foot points downward and appears to touch the pale studio floor with the tips of its toes, or to have just lifted from it. The torso leans and folds as an arm draws back, and the long soft fabric swings outward from the waist and elbows. Textured seams and mottled gray-brown smudges break the otherwise pale costume. A narrow dark contact shadow near the bottom grounds the action, and the junction of wall and floor is only subtly visible. Diffuse studio light from the upper left shapes the hat rim, folds, muscles, and feet with soft highlights and gentle gray shadow, without hard theatrical spots. The shutter freezes the unstable instant sharply enough to preserve the crisp edges of the hat and feet. The composition uses muted tonal restraint and a large unadorned backdrop to turn a human movement into an elegant angular gesture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形艺术摄影棚照片将一个赤脚舞者单独置于平滑暖灰墙前，捕捉扭转、失衡般的腾跃。人物在中央附近，却从左上向右下斜伸，动作周围留有大面积空灰。宽大的白色帽檐前倾，完全遮住面孔，使姿势有匿名的雕塑感。舞者穿宽松、略显磨旧的奶油色与灰褐色衣服：长袖、层叠上衣和裁剪宽阔的裤子，布料在弯曲关节附近聚起褶皱。一边膝盖高高折向胸前，另一条腿向右踢出，赤脚伸展。另一只脚向下，似乎以脚尖轻触浅色棚地，或者刚从地上抬起。上身倾斜折叠，一只手臂向后收，柔软长布从腰间和肘部向外甩动。有纹理的衣缝和斑驳灰棕色痕迹打破服装的大块浅色。底部附近狭窄的深色接触影使动作落地，墙与地面的接线仅隐约可见。左上方漫射摄影棚光以软亮部和温和灰影塑出帽缘、衣褶、肌肉和双脚，没有生硬的戏剧追光。快门把不稳定瞬间凝住，帽子和脚的边缘仍足够清晰。构图用克制的低饱和调子与大面积无装饰背景，把人体动作变成优雅的折角手势。
style_prompt_en: Fine-art studio photography freezes motion against a seamless, matte, midtone field. Use large areas of quiet negative space so a single complex gesture can read clearly. Diffuse side light reveals folds, skin, and material wear through restrained highlights and soft contact shadow rather than high contrast. Keep the palette nearly monochrome in warm gray, cream, and taupe, with subtle texture and no distracting props. Place the subject on a diagonal with one small point of grounding, while fabric and limbs flare into angular and flowing rhythms. Concealed or simplified facial detail can shift attention toward shape, balance, and suspended time. The result is spare, physical, and sculptural.
style_prompt_zh: 艺术摄影棚摄影把动作冻结在无缝、哑光的中间调背景前。保留大面积安静负空间，让一个复杂手势清楚可读。漫射侧光用克制亮部与柔和接触影呈现衣褶、皮肤和材料磨痕，而非高反差。配色近乎单色，围绕暖灰、奶油白与灰褐色，保留细微纹理，不添分散注意力的道具。主体沿对角线展开，以一处微小触地点稳住，布料与肢体向外形成折角和流动节奏。遮蔽或简化面部细节能把注意力移到形体、平衡与悬置的时间。效果简洁、富于身体性与雕塑感。
theme_en: A barefoot dancer suspended in a twisting leap against a gray studio wall
theme_zh: 赤脚舞者在灰色摄影棚墙前腾空扭转
name: Bertil Nilsson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
